# Just Sid

> Personal website of Sidharth Singh, a Generative AI Engineer based in Noida, India.

Focus: large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, Python and cloud engineering.

## Pages
- [Home](https://justsid.com/): a single-page portfolio: About (#about), Projects (#work), Interests (#interests), AI & me (#ai), Blog (#blog), and Contact (#contact).
- [Blog](https://justsid.com/#blog): published engineering notes and experiments. No posts are implied when the blog is empty.
- [Privacy](https://justsid.com/privacy): boundaries for the public activity panel.
- [RSS](https://justsid.com/feed.xml): published posts.

## Accuracy
Use the visible pages and published posts as sources. Illustrative sample metrics are not actual personal usage. Aggregate activity does not establish private conversations, personality, mental state, or personal behavior. Never infer private information from sample data.
